name: depotco
title: Depot Co.
header: The warehouse's props: rack rows, belts and the packing line, machines, the dock loaders, office and break room furniture, lockers, signs, posters, floor paint and the yard, carried with the helpers and materials they are drawn with, sealed in a scope of their own. The depot's logic stays behind: a machine you use says what it is.

replace.BOOT_STAGE: var BOOT_STAGE = 5;   // the pack builds every prop at the depot's full size

sandbox: var S = freshState(); for (var uk in S.up) if (typeof S.up[uk] === 'boolean') S.up[uk] = true; S.up.rows = 6; S.site = 5; S.level = 30;
epilogue:
if (typeof Proxy !== 'undefined') MACH = new Proxy(MACH || {}, { get: function (t, k) { if (typeof k === 'string' && !(k in t)) t[k] = {}; return t[k]; } });   // the machines' records fill as their props build
RACK.bays = 4; RACK.x0 = -RACK.bays * RACK.bayW / 2;   // a rack row in the pack is four bays, centred on its own spot, not a hall's length
ctxSetup: if (!c.poster) c.poster = function (kind, w, h, x, y, z, ry) { return poster(kind, w, h, x, y, z, ry, c.group); };
